about: Steps the autopilot may take only after the owner approves. The owner sets status to approved (in chat, or by editing this file); agents act only on approved items and add new ones as pending.

items.what: Let the tester agent run AurumFunded in Terminal 16 (job j3). run-tester links the repo's AurumFunded folder into that terminal and recompiles it there, so first back up the terminal's current AurumFunded folder.
items.note: Owner approved in chat. Backup made first: Terminal 16 data folder, backup\2026-10-17_before_repo_link (the old AurumFunded folder and its three presets). Terminal 16's AurumFunded is now linked to the repo.

items.what: Step 19: buy a challenge or go live. Never automated: the owner does it, after a yes in chat.

Step 17 for the breakout and noise legs: turn both on in the FTMO demo's AurumFunded (Terminal 16, inputs InpBreakRiskPct=0.125 and InpNoiseMult=0.275 on the attached chart; nothing else changes).
